jobs.description: Die Universität Paderborn ist eine leistungsstarke und international orientierte Campus-Universität. In interdisziplinären Teams gestalten wir zukunftsweisende Forschung, innovative Lehre sowie den aktiven Wissenstransfer in die Gesellschaft. Als wichtige Forschungs- und Kooperationspartnerin prägt die Universität auch regionale Entwicklungsstrategien. Unseren Beschäftigten in Forschung, Lehre, Technik und Verwaltung bieten wir ein lebendiges, familienfreundliches und chancengerechtes Arbeitsumfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und vielfältigen Möglichkeiten. Gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft!In der Fakultät für Elektrotechnik, Informatik und Mathematik ist am Institut für Informatik – Computergrafik und Visualisierung – zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine Stelle alswissenschaftliche*r Mitarbeiter*in (w/m/d)(Entgeltgruppe 13 TV-L)im Umfang von 100 % der regelmäßigen Arbeitszeit zu besetzen. Es handelt sich um eine zunächst bis zum 28. Februar 2030 wegen Drittmittelfinanzierung im Sinne des Wissenschaftszeitvertragsgesetzes (WissZeitVG) befristete Tätigkeit. Die Befristungsdauer entspricht dem voraussichtlich bewilligten Projektzeitraum. Die Möglichkeit zur Promotion/wissenschaftlichen Weiterqualifikation ist gegeben.Die Fachgruppe unter der Leitung von Prof. Dr. Marcel Campen, https://cgv.cs.upb.de, ist im Bereich der Computergrafik, gemessen an Publikationen auf der renommiertesten internationalen Fachkonferenz SIGGRAPH, eine der sichtbarsten in Deutschland. Hier haben Sie die Chance, in einem motivierten Teamumfeld hochrelevante Forschungsherausforderungen in Angriff zu nehmen und aktiv den Stand der Technik voranzutreiben!Idealerweise verfügen Sie bereits über vertiefte fachliche Kenntnisse auf mehreren Gebieten, die das unten erläuterte Projektthema berühren. Dies sind etwa Netzalgorithmen, Netzdatenstrukturen, numerische Optimierung, kombinatorische Optimierung, Diskrete Geometrie und Topologie. Ebenso vorteilhaft sind ausführliche Programmierkenntnisse, insbesondere in C++.Projektbeschreibung und Aufgaben:• Forschung im Rahmen des DFG-Forschungsprojekts „Hierarchical Computational 3D Solid Mapping“. Dabei werden Sie vor allem mitarbeiten am Entwurf, der Entwicklung und der Analyse neuer Algorithmen zur verlässlichen und effizienten Berechnung bijektiver Abbildungen zwischen 3D-Objekten, auf Basis von Tetraeder- oder Polyeder-Netzen. Zu den nächstverwandten bisherigen Arbeiten zählen Artikel wie:- „Bijective Volumetric Mapping via Star Decomposition”- „Bijective Maps from Simplicial Foliations”- „Galaxy Maps: Localized Foliations for Bijective Volumetric Mapping”- „Stripe Embedding: Efficient Maps with Exact Numeric Computation”- „Divide-and-Conquer Embedding“• Publikation, Präsentation und Transfer von Forschungsergebnissen• Lehrverpflichtung im Umfang von i. d. R. 4 SWS im Bereich Computergrafik / Geometry Processing / VisualisierungEinstellungsvoraussetzungen:• Wissenschaftlicher Hochschulabschluss (Master oder vergleichbar) in Informatik, Mathematik oder einem eng verwandten Fach• Promotion für die Einstellung als Postdoc• Solide Englischkenntnisse in Schrift und Wort• Solide Kenntnisse im fachlichen Umfeld des ForschungsprojektthemasWir bieten Ihnen:• Flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung sowie die individuelle Möglichkeit zur mobilen Arbeit• Vielzahl von Gesundheits-, Beratungs- und Präventionsangeboten• Attraktive Nebenleistungen wie Kinderbetreuungsmöglichkeiten und Sportangebote• Möglichkeit zur internen und externen Fort- und Weiterbildung• Zusätzliche Leistungen nach dem Tarifvertrag der Länder (TV-L) wie Jahressonderzahlung und vermögenswirksame Leistungen sowie die Zusatzversorgung der VBLBewerbungen von Frauen sind ausdrücklich erwünscht und werden gem. Landesgleichstellungsgesetz NRW (LGG) bei gleicher Eignung, Befähigung und fachlicher Leistung bevorzugt berücksichtigt, sofern nicht in der Person eines Mitbewerbers liegende Gründe überwiegen. Teilzeitbeschäftigung ist grundsätzlich möglich. Ebenso ist die Bewerbung geeigneter Schwerbehinderter und Gleichgestellter im Sinne des Sozialgesetzbuches Neuntes Buch (SGB IX) erwünscht.Bewerbungen mit den üblichen Unterlagen (insbesondere Anschreiben, Lebenslauf, Zeugnisse und Leistungsübersichten, ggf. vorhandene Empfehlungsschreiben oder Arbeitszeugnisse) werden bevorzugt in einer PDF-Datei und unter Angabe der Kennziffer 7440 bis zum 06. Dezember 2026 erbeten an: sek-cgv@lists.uni-paderborn.de.Fragen zur Stelle können vorab an Prof. Dr. Marcel Campen (marcel.campen@uni-paderborn.de) gerichtet werden.Informationen zur Verarbeitung Ihrer personenbezogenen Daten finden Sie unter: www.uni-paderborn.de/zv/personaldatenschutz.Prof. Dr. Marcel CampenFakultät für Elektrotechnik, Informatik und MathematikUniversität PaderbornWarburger Str. 10033098 PaderbornPaderborn University is a high-performance and internationally oriented university. Within interdisciplinary teams, we undertake forward-looking research, design innovative teaching concepts and actively transfer knowledge into society. As an important research and cooperation partner, the university also shapes regional development strategies. We offer our employees in research, teaching, technology and administration a lively, family-friendly and equal opportunity environment, a lean management structure and diverse opportunities. Join us to invent the future!In the Faculty of Computer Science, Electrical Engineering and Mathematics at the Department of Computer Science – Research Group Computer Graphics and Visualization – the following position is to be filled as soon as possibleResearch Assistant (f/m/d)(Salary level according to 13 TV-L)with 100 % of the regular working hours. This is a fixed-term position initially limited until February 28th, 2030 due to third-party funding within the meaning of the German Act on Fixed-Term Research Employment Contracts for Academic Staff (Wissenschaftszeitvertragsgesetz “WissZeitVG”). The duration of the fixed term corresponds to the prospective approved project period. The possibility of a doctorate or further academic qualification is provided.The research group led by Prof. Dr. Marcel Campen, https://cgv.cs.upb.de, judging by publications at the field’s most renowned international conference SIGGRAPH, is one of the most visible in the field of Computer Graphics in Germany. Here you have the chance to, in a motivated team environment, tackle highly relevant and timely research challenges and actively push forward the current state of the art!Ideally, you already possess in-depth knowledge in multiple areas that touch on the project topic detailed below. These include mesh algorithms, mesh data structures, numerical optimization, combinatorial optimization, discrete geometry and topology. Likewise beneficial is extended programming experience, especially in C++.Scope of Work:• Research in the context of the DFG-funded research project „SolidMaps 2: Hierarchical Computational 3D Solid Mapping“. Above all, you will work on the design, development, and analysis of novel algorithms for the reliable and efficient computation of bijective maps between 3D objects, on the basis of tetrahedral or polyhedral meshes. Closest prior work includes the articles:- “Bijective Volumetric Mapping via Star Decomposition”- “Bijective Maps from Simplicial Foliations”- “Galaxy Maps: Localized Foliations for Bijective Volumetric Mapping”- “Stripe Embedding: Efficient Maps with Exact Numeric Computation”- “Divide-and-Conquer Embedding”• Publication, presentation, and transfer of research results• Teaching duties usually amounting to 4 teaching hours (SWS) per week in the areas computer graphics / geometry processing / visualizationRecruitment requirements:• Scientific university degree (Master or equivalent) in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a closely related subject• Ph.D. for the postdoc position• Solid command of written and spoken English• Solid knowledge in the thematic context of the research project topicWe offer:• Flexible working hours and the individual option of mobile working• Wide range of health, counseling and prevention services• Attractive fringe benefits such as childcare facilities and sports activities• Opportunities for internal and external training and development• Additional benefits in accordance with the collective agreement of the federal states (TV-L), such as annual bonuses and capital-forming benefits as well as the VBL supplementary pension schemeApplications from women are particularly welcome and, in case of equal qualifications and experiences, will receive preferential treatment according to to state law (LGG), unless there are preponderant reasons to give preference to another applicant. Part-time employment is generally possible. Applications from disabled people with appropriate suitability are explicitly welcome. This also applies to people with equal opportunities in accordance with the German social law SGB IX.Please send your application documents (in particular cover letter, CV, certificates and transcripts of record, and possibly recommendation/reference letters), preferably in a single pdf file, using the Ref. No. 7440 until December 06th, 2026 to sek-cgv@lists.uni-paderborn.de.Questions regarding this position can be directed ahead to Prof. Dr. Marcel Campen (marcel.campen@uni-paderborn.de).Information regarding the processing of your personal data can be located at:https://www.uni-paderborn.de/en/zv/personaldatenschutz.Prof. Dr. Marcel CampenFaculty of Computer Science, Electrical Engineering and MathematicsPaderborn UniversityWarburger Str. 10033098 Paderborn

jobs.occupation: PhD student development and optimization of aqueous battery systems (Ingenieur/in - Materialwissenschaften)
jobs.description: The PhD candidate will work within the national project, which aims to establish an integrated high-throughput research platform combining robotic battery experimentation, and AI‑assisted data analysis. The focus of this PhD project is the development and optimization of aqueous battery systems through automated electrolyte screening, electrochemical testing, and molecular structure-performance correlation. Selected electrolyte systems and degradation scenarios will be additionally studied through targeted operando tomography experiments.Equal opportunity is an important part of our personnel policy. We would therefore strongly encourage qualified women to apply for the position. The position is full time and fixed-term from February 2027 for 3 years.It involves extensive experimental laboratory work, automated testing, electrochemical characterization, data analysis, and collaboration with beamline scientists and industrial partners. The candidate will contribute to the development of next-generation data-driven battery research workflows for sustainable energy storage technologies.Your tasks:- develop and optimize the high-throughput automated workflow for composition engineering of aqueous electrolytes for batteries.- investigate interfacial degradation, and electrolyte-electrode interactions.- correlate electrochemical performance with structural and morphological descriptors obtained from advanced synchrotron and X-ray imaging techniques.- analyze large experimental datasets and contribute to AI‑assisted materials discovery and experimental design workflows.- collaborate closely with project partners from research institutes and industryYour profile:Recruitment requirement- completed university studies and a master's degree in the subject areas of Materials science, Electrochemistry, Chemical Engineering, Energy Engineering, or a comparable university degreeRequired knowledge and personal skills- strong background in electrochemistry and battery technologies- Hands-on laboratory experience and interest in experimental research- experience with electrochemical measurements and data analysis- ability to work independently and as part of an interdisciplinary research team- very good English language skills (at least B2/C1 level according to CEFR)Desired knowledge and personal skills- experience with aqueous batteries, Zn-ion batteries, metal-anode batteries, or electrolyte development- knowledge of electrochemical techniques such as EIS, cyclic voltammetry- experience with materials characterization techniques, such as microscopy, X-ray methods, or tomography- familiarity with automated experimentation, robotics, data science, or machine learning is advantageousGot questions before applying? Contact Prof. Zheludkevich (Mikhail.zheludkevich@hereon.de) , Dr. Lamaka (Sviatlana.lamaka@hereon.de) or Dr. Snihirova (darya.snihirova@hereon.de).Our offer:- an exciting and varied job in a research center with around 1,000 employees from more than 60 nations- an International Welcome Office with guest accommodation- 6 weeks holiday per year; company holidays between Christmas and New Year's Day- social benefits under the collective agreement for the German public sector and remuneration up to pay grade 13 (EntgO Bund)- very good work-life balance; options for mobile and flexible working- a well-connected research campus, good networking opportunities, a subsidized Deutschlandticket (job ticket) subject to certain conditions, and charging facilities for electric vehicles- individual opportunities for training and development- an excellent technical infrastructure and modern workplace equipment- Collaboration with industrial partners, combining industry and academia- Opportunities to publish, patent and contribute to a real product design- PhD Buddy Program- a family-friendly working environment with childcare options, e.g. a daycare center close to the workplace- workplace health promotion programmes, e.g. an Employee Assistance Program (EAP)- Corporate Benefits- a varied canteen offering on campusSchwerbehinderte und diesen gleichgestellte behinderte Personen werden bei gleicher Qualifikation und Eignung im Rahmen der gesetzlichen Bestimmungen bevorzugt berücksichtigt.Bitte bewerben Sie sich mit Ihrem vollständigen Bewerbungsprofil (Lebenslauf, Motivationsschreiben, sonstige Referenzen) über unsere Karriereseite.

jobs.description: For english translation see further down------------------------------------------------------------------Über unsWir eröffnen eine neue Filiale unserer Praxis Gute Gelenke – Praxis für Physiotherapie zentral am Bertha‑von‑Suttner‑Platz in Bonn. Unsere Praxis steht für moderne, ganzheitliche Physiotherapie, bei der der Mensch im Mittelpunkt steht. Our practice is dedicated to modern, holistic physical therapy that puts the individual at the center. We help people achieve pain-free mobility and ensure lasting improvements in health and quality of life.Your ResponsibilitiesIndependently developing and implementing individualized treatment plansSupporting and motivating patients on their journey toward their health goalsEmpathetic care and active communicationDocumenting treatment progressParticipating in practice processes and internal trainingTeam-oriented collaboration in a dynamic practice environmentYour ProfileCompleted training as a physical therapistEnjoy working with people and taking initiativeStrong communication skills, empathy, and ability to work in a teamCareer starters are just as welcome as experienced professionalsWe offerPermanent full-time position with performance-based compensationFlexible work schedules (full-time & part-time)Modern, well-equipped practice facilities in a central location in BonnInternal and external continuing education and trainingA supportive team with flat hierarchiesJob ticket, optional company bike or company carCareer development opportunities within a growing network of practicesInterested?Then send your application with your resume and your earliest start date via email to:praxis@gutegelenke.deErgänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Grundkenntnisse: Manuelle Therapie

jobs.description: Electrical Field Service Technician (m/f/d)located in Kiel At Caterpillar, we’re committed to our customers, who build a better, more sustainable world with our products, services and solutions. We understand and show the value of why they should choose us. We’re exploring new ideas and opportunities – innovating to discover the breakthroughs necessary for tomorrow’s growth. Through it all, we are one team (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mYIDne7Q5ek&list=PLwAXbfivFg0jmiNqqgFLeQJpRB_i-UVln&index=39)  – creating and delivering world-class products, services and solutions superior to the competition. Learn more about the Caterpillar Experience (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GvCYWtWARlk&list=PLwAXbfivFg0jmiNqqgFLeQJpRB_i-UVln&index=25) . Caterpillar Inc. is the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel-electric locomotives.As an Electrical Field Service Technician, you will provide technical support for installation, commissioning, troubleshooting, maintenance and repair of electrical, automation and control systems associated with medium-speed diesel, gas and dual-fuel engines. You will work closely with customers, dealers, shipyards and internal technical specialists to ensure safe, reliable and efficient operation of Caterpillar Motoren products worldwide. Job duties will include but are not limited to:- Perform maintenance, installation, troubleshooting and repair activities on electrical, automation and control systems of Caterpillar Motoren products.- Provide technical support directly to customers and through the Caterpillar dealer network.- Perform diagnostics and fault finding on MACS, aMACS and associated automation platforms.- Troubleshoot electrical distribution systems, switchboards, motor control centers (MCCs), excitation systems and generator protection equipment.- Support synchronization, load sharing and load acceptance testing of generator sets.- Conduct root cause analyses and support major failure investigations.- Analyze wiring diagrams, schematics, protection philosophies and control logic documentation.- Support electrical upgrades, retrofit projects and software updates.- Prepare detailed troubleshooting and service reports.- Utilize Caterpillar digital service tools, remote diagnostics and technical information systems.- Support warranty investigations and implementation of corrective actions.- Provide technical guidance and mentoring to dealers, contractors and customer personnel.- Participate continuously in technical training programs to maintain and expand product knowledge.- Perform workshop activities, panel inspections and equipment testing when not assigned to field service activities.- Support special service projects assigned by the Team Leader.Safety Responsibilities- Perform all work in compliance with Caterpillar Environmental, Health and Safety requirements- Follow customer-specific electrical safety procedures, lockout/tagout (LOTO) requirements and permit-to-work systems.- Verify equipment isolation and safe working conditions before commencing work.- Actively promote a strong safety culture and immediately report unsafe conditions.- Ensure risk assessments and toolbox talks are completed where required.- Comply with applicable marine, offshore and power plant electrical safety standards.What You Have (Key Skills/Experience Required): - Completed vocational training as Electrical Technician, Electronics Technician, Mechatronics Technician, Marine Electrical Engineer or comparable technical qualification.- Minimum 2-4 years of field service experience with power generation, marine electrical systems, industrial automation or engine control systems.- Strong troubleshooting and diagnostic skills for electrical and automation systems.- Experience with generator protection systems, switchgear and power distribution systems is advantageous.- Familiarity with electrical power generation, protection and automation systems. Knowledge of IEC 61850 communication networks, generator protection relays and power management systems is advantageous.- Familiarity with generator synchronization and load sharing systems is advantageous.- Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams and control drawings.- Good written and spoken English skills for communication with international customers and dealers.- Strong customer focus and professional communication skills.- High level of self-organization and ability to work independently.- Willingness and ability to travel internationally up to 80%, including short-notice assignments and extended customer site visits.- Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications and digital service reporting tools.- Ability to obtain required travel documentation, visas and medical clearances necessary for international assignments.- Valid offshore medical certificate and/or fitness for international travel assignments is advantageous.What Will Put You Ahead (Preferred Skills):- Generator Protection Relays (Woodward, ABB REG, Siemens SIPROTEC)- Power Management Systems (PMS)- Governor Systems (Woodward, Regulateur Europas, Heinzmann)- Variable Frequency Drives (ABB, Danfoss, Siemens)- High Voltage Switching Authorization- Marine Automation Systems- Industrial Ethernet and Network Diagnostics- Experience with LNG, Dual-Fuel or Gas Engine ControlsWhat You Will Get:•    Varied and challenging responsibilities•    Attractive salary in line with the applicable collective agreement (starting from €3,977, depending on your experience)•    Additional payments such as holiday pay, Christmas bonus, etc.•    30 days of annual leave / working time account•    Company pension scheme•    Bike leasing / public transport ticket / wellbeing allowanceAdditional Information:We are back! This role requires being in the office five days a week.Note - Relocation assistance may be provided to candidates who meet the eligibility criteria.A valid work permit or EU-25/EFTA citizenship is required for this position.About CaterpillarCaterpillar Inc. is the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel-electric locomotives. For the past 100 years, we’ve been helping customers build a better, more sustainable world and are committed and contributing to a reduced-carbon future. Our innovative products and services, backed by our global dealer network, provide exceptional value that helps customers succeed.We value authenticity and encourage candidates to submit original, personally crafted responses throughout our hiring process. Use of AI-generated content may disadvantage your application.

Die Universität Paderborn ist eine leistungsstarke und international orientierte Campus-Universität. In interdisziplinären Teams gestalten wir zukunftsweisende Forschung, innovative Lehre sowie den aktiven Wissenstransfer in die Gesellschaft. Als wichtige Forschungs- und Kooperationspartnerin prägt die Universität auch regionale Entwicklungsstrategien. Unseren Beschäftigten in Forschung, Lehre, Technik und Verwaltung bieten wir ein lebendiges, familienfreundliches und chancengerechtes Arbeitsumfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und vielfältigen Möglichkeiten. Gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft!In der Fakultät für Naturwissenschaften – Department Chemie – ist im Rahmen des interdisziplinären Forschungsvorhabens ML4Fouling zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine Stelle alswissenschaftliche*r Mitarbeiter*in (Post-Doc) (w/m/d) (Entgeltgruppe 13 TV-L)im Umfang von 100 % der regelmäßigen Arbeitszeit zu besetzen. Es handelt sich um eine Qualifizierungsstelle im Sinne des Wissenschaftszeitvertragsgesetzes (WissZeitVG), die zur Förderung der folgenden wiss. Qualifizierung besetzt wird: Projektakquise und -management im Bereich der Naturwissenschaften. Die Stelle ist befristet, abhängig von der bisher erreichten Qualifizierung, jedoch für die Dauer von i. d. R. 2 Jahren zu besetzen, da dieser Zeitraum zur Förderung des Qualifizierungsziels als angemessen angesehen wird.Aufgabenbereich:• Durchführung experimenteller (u. a. elektrochemischer, spektroskopischer, mikroskopischer) Analysen zur Detektion initialerAblagerungsprozesse an umströmten Oberflächen• Analyse des Einflusses von Materialeigenschaften, Fluidzusammensetzung und Strömungsbedingungen auf makromolekulareAblagerungsprozesse• Atomistische Simulation (sowohl DFT- als auch Kraftfeld-basiert) von Adsorptions- und Desorptionsprozessen an Fest-Flüssig-Grenzflächen• Entwicklung und Validierung von Machine-Learning-Modellen zur Vorhersage der Belagsbildung in technischen und medizintechnischenSystemen• Präsentation der wissenschaftlichen Erkenntnisse in nationalen und internationalen Konferenzen• Publikation der wissenschaftlichen Erkenntnisse in internationalen Fachzeitschriften• Lehrverpflichtung im Umfang von i. d. R. 4 SWS, primär in deutschsprachigen VeranstaltungenEinstellungsvoraussetzungen:• Abgeschlossene Promotion in Chemie, Physik, Materialwissenschaft oder einem verwandten naturwissenschaftlichen Bereich• Nachgewiesene Kenntnisse im Bereich Elektrochemie, Grenzflächenchemie und/oder -analytik sowie atomistischen Simulationen• Kenntnisse im Bereich maschinelles Lernen und/oder in der Arbeit mit datengetriebenen Methoden sowie der Erzeugung entsprechenderTrainingsdaten sind wünschenswert• Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und SchriftWir bieten Ihnen:• Ein interdisziplinäres Forschungsumfeld an der Schnittstelle von Technischer Chemie, Theoretischer Chemie und Machine-Learning• Abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit in einem universitätsintern ausgezeichneten Forschungsprojekt• Zugang zu den Hochleistungsrechnern des Paderborn Center for Parallel Computing (PC2)• Flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung sowie die individuelle Möglichkeit zur mobilen Arbeit• Vielzahl von Gesundheits-, Beratungs- und Präventionsangeboten• Attraktive Nebenleistungen wie Kinderbetreuungsmöglichkeiten und Sportangebote• Möglichkeit zur internen und externen Fort- und Weiterbildung• Zusätzliche Leistungen nach dem Tarifvertrag der Länder (TV-L) wie Jahressonderzahlung und vermögenswirksame Leistungen sowie dieZusatzversorgung der VBLBewerbungen von Frauen sind ausdrücklich erwünscht und werden gem. Landesgleichstellungsgesetz NRW (LGG) bei gleicher Eignung, Befähigung und fachlicher Leistung bevorzugt berücksichtigt, sofern nicht in der Person eines Mitbewerbers liegende Gründe überwiegen. Teilzeitbeschäftigung ist grundsätzlich möglich. Ebenso ist die Bewerbung geeigneter Schwerbehinderter und Gleichgestellter im Sinne des Sozialgesetzbuches Neuntes Buch (SGB IX) erwünscht.Bewerbungen mit den üblichen Unterlagen werden unter Angabe der Kennziffer 7460 bis zum 4. Dezember 2026 erbeten an vanessa.nesslinger@unipaderborn.de.Informationen zur Verarbeitung Ihrer personenbezogenen Daten finden Sie unter:www.uni-paderborn.de/zv/personaldatenschutz.Prof. Dr. Martin BrehmFakultät für NaturwissenschaftenUniversität PaderbornWarburger Str. 10033098 PaderbornPaderborn University is a high-performance and internationally oriented university. Within interdisciplinary teams, we undertake forward-looking research, design innovative teaching concepts and actively transfer knowledge into society. As an important research and cooperation partner, the university also shapes regional development strategies. We offer our employees in research, teaching, technology and administration a lively, family-friendly and equal opportunity environment, a lean management structure and diverse opportunities. Join us to invent the future!As part of the interdisciplinary research project ML4Fouling, at the Faculty of Science – Department of Chemistry –, the following position is to be filled as soon as possiblePostdoctoral Researcher (f/m/d)(Salary level according to 13 TV-L)with 100% of the regular working hours. This is a qualification position within the meaning of the German Act on Fixed-Term Research Employment Contracts for Academic Staff (Wissenschaftszeitvertragsgesetz “WissZeitVG”), which serves to promote the following academic qualification: project acquisition and management in natural sciences. The position is initially limited for a period of two years.Duties and responsibilities:• Conducting experimental (including electrochemical, spectroscopic, and microscopic) analyses to detect initial adsorption processes on surfaces exposed to fluid flow• Analyzing the influence of material properties, fluid composition, and flow conditions on macromolecular deposition processes• Atomistic simulation (both DFT- and force-field-based) of adsorption and desorption processes at solid-liquid interfaces• Developing and validating predictive machine learning (ML) models for deposition processes in technical and biomedical systems• Presenting scientific findings at national and international conferences• Publishing scientific findings in international peer-reviewed journals• Teaching duties usually amounting to 4 teaching hours (SWS) per week, primarily in German-language coursesRecruitment requirements:• Completed PhD in chemistry, physics, materials science, or a related field in the natural sciences• Proven knowledge in the fields of electrochemistry, interface chemistry and/or interface analysis, as well as atomistic simulations• Knowledge in the field of machine learning and/or in working with data-driven methods, as well as the generation of corresponding training data, is desirable• Excellent written and spoken English skillsWe offer:• An interdisciplinary research environment bridging technical chemistry, theoretical chemistry, and machine learning• The opportunity to be part of a research project recognized with a university award• Access to the high-performance computing facilities of the Paderborn Center for Parallel Computing (PC2)• Flexible working hours and the individual option of mobile working• Wide range of health, counseling and prevention services• Attractive fringe benefits such as childcare facilities and sports activities• Opportunities for internal and external training and development• Additional benefits in accordance with the collective agreement of the federal states (TV-L), such as annual bonuses and capital-forming benefits as well as the VBL supplementary pension schemeApplications from women are particularly welcome and, in case of equal qualifications and experiences, will receive preferential treatment according to state law (LGG), unless there are preponderant reasons to give preference to another applicant. Part-time employment is generally possible. Applications from disabled people with appropriate suitability are explicitly welcome. This also applies to people with equal opportunities in accordance with the German social law SGB IX.Please send your application documents (preferably in a single pdf file) using the Ref. No. 7460 until December, 4th 2026 to vanessa.nesslinger@uni-paderborn.de.
